metadata.title: The New Zealand Mine With One Way Out
metadata.description:
Pike River exploded, trapping its workers underground. The cause: methane explosion in a mine with inadequate gas drainage and a single exit.

Failure chain: Methane drainage inadequate → Gas warnings repeated → Explosion → Only one way out → More explosions follow

Related episode: Why the Ajka Red Mud Reservoir Failed — https://youtu.be/JAKAYnkbxd8

Technical references:
• Wikipedia — Pike River Mine disaster — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pike_River_Mine_disaster
• Government source — Pike River Mine Factsheet 201117  (cited by Wikipedia) — https://www.beehive.govt.nz/sites/default/files/2017-11/Pike%20River%20Mine%20Factsheet%20201117%20.pdf

Narration uses a synthetic voice. Original animation: no archival or stock footage; reconstructions and illustrations are labelled on screen.
